title: Ambitious green transition
audience_pitch: The city goes all in: bigger budget, double the operations money. Is it worth it?
narrative: Nearly every zone gets a station and rebalancing keeps them stocked, so almost no rider is turned away -- even on the Sunday leisure pattern. But the KPIs show diminishing returns: each additional euro buys fewer new served trips than in S2, and the cost per served trip rises. The lesson for the audience: 'more' is not automatically 'better spent', and quantifying that trade-off is exactly what the optimisation model is for.

expected_story.service: highest coverage and availability, Monday and Sunday alike
expected_story.economics: largest investment; highest cost per served trip -- diminishing returns made visible
